With

"State of Uttarakhand Vs. Malkeet Singh"
Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned AGA for the State of
Uttarakhand/Appellant.
2. Mr. Anand Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the
Respondent.
3. The present application has been filed by the
Appellant/State seeking special leave to appeal against the
judgment and order dated 28.08.2025 passed by the court of
learned Special Judge (NDPS Act), District Udham Singh
Nagar in Special Session Trial No.9 of 2015, "State Vs.
Malkeet Singh" under Sections 8/18 of the Narcotic Drugs
and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985, whereby the
accused/Respondent - Malkeet Singh, had been acquitted by
the learned Trial Court.
4. After hearing the learned counsel for the Appellant, the
present matter needs deliberation, this Court is satisfied that
the Appellant has made out a prima facie case warranting
consideration. Special leave to appeal is granted.
5. The application is treated as an appeal and is admitted.
6. Heard on the delay condonation application.
7. The delay is of 42 days' in filing the present
government appeal.
8. This Court finds ground for condonation of the delay is
sufficient. For the reasons indicated in the delay condonation
application, the same is allowed, and the delay in filing
government appeal is hereby condoned.

9. The matter needs consideration. Let the Trial Court
Record be summoned. After receipt of the same, let the paper-book be prepared and supplied to the learned counsel for the
parties on the payment of usual charges.
10. List this matter on 09.06.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
28.04.2026
Nitesh/
